status.en: 95 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 20% fewer than the week before, most of them in Islamabad, Balochistan and Peshawar.
status.nb: 95 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 20 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Islamabad, Belutsjistan og Peshawar.

summary.en: Militant gunmen attacked a polio vaccination team in Mohmand, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, killing two policemen and wounding another, while a PIA engineer was killed in a separate attack in Karachi. Pakistani forces returned fire on Afghan Taliban posts in South Waziristan after Taliban fire on Pakistani posts, intensifying border clashes. Soaring LPG prices are forcing rickshaw drivers to cut meals, adding economic pressure on commuters. The conflict caused 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Militantvåpnede menn angrep et poliovaksinasjonsteam i Mohmand, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, og drepte to politifolk og såret en annen, mens en PIA-ingeniør ble drept i et separat angrep i Karachi. Pakistanske styrker svarte med ild mot afghanske Taliban-poster i Sør-Waziristan etter at Taliban skjøt mot pakistanske poster, og intensiverte grensekonfliktene. Stigende LPG-priser tvinger rickshaw-sjåfører til å kutte måltider, noe som legger ekstra økonomisk press på pendlere. Konflikten forårsaket 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
